hypothesis: The TypeCheck class fails to correctly iterate through function arguments when a var_args parameter is present. prediction: The loop condition in TypeCheck.java (likely within a method responsible for checking function call arguments) will be found to be too restrictive, causing it to stop checking arguments as soon as the formal parameter iterator is empty, ignoring the var_args capability.
experiment_rationale: The failure is a classic off-by-one or loop-termination logic error in an iterative process (checking function arguments). The provided fix diff confirms this by modifying the loop condition to continue if a var_args parameter is present.
reasoning_summary: The bug is a failure to validate all arguments in a function call when var_args are used. This is a procedural/algorithmic error in the type-checking logic.
